title: Business Analyst - Bangkok

fails: Requires the degree to be completed when you apply; yours is conferred after May 2027.

reasons.love: Customer-facing commercial work close to his preferred Key Account track.
reasons.good_at: Some overlap via F26 (reporting); the domain experience the JD wants is not evidenced.
reasons.needs: Structured rotations and a published path to manager at a growing regional company.
reasons.paid: Estimate: the posting states no salary. THB 65,000+ per month. for a comparable Bangkok graduate role.

summary: Eligibility barrier: see the gate reasons.
jd_text: McKinsey & Company is hiring for Business Analyst - Bangkok in Bangkok, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
